operations.summary: Verify a DNS provider credential against its upstream API
operations.description: Requires dns.manage in the active scope, an empty request body, a quoted If-Match revision, and an Idempotency-Key. The first implemented adapter verifies a Cloudflare API Token with GET /user/tokens/verify. A verified result proves token activity only; it does not prove zone-specific permissions, mutate DNS records, or start ACME issuance. Deterministic denials are audited and idempotently replayed. Rate limits, timeouts, upstream failures, and invalid upstream responses leave the provider unchanged and the key retryable.

responses.description: The token is active and the provider is now verified, or an identical completed request was replayed.

fields.name: provider_type
fields.type: string: aliyun / cloudflare / huawei / dnspod_cn / dns_com / dns_la / namecom / custom_http / dnsdun
fields.description: dnsdun is a disabled legacy read-only value; new configurations use dns_la.

fields.name: managed_by
fields.description: tenant = an account the tenant entered; platform = the read-only platform DNS copy (only the platform-allocated CNAME records and platform administrators use it; dns_provider_platform_managed otherwise)
